## Work

- [HandleScout](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/handlescout): High-performance handle verification tool that checks real-time username availability across Instagram, TikTok, X, and YouTube. Responsive frontend with validation and optimized multi-platform API calls to streamline branding workflows.
- [Type Racer](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/type-racer): Responsive typing game with live WPM tracking, DOM-based feedback, and animations. Selectable text lengths and real-time correctness highlighting.
- [Nearest Washroom Finder](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/washroom-finder): Location-based app to find public washrooms within 1.5 km using Overpass API and device geolocation. Interactive map and mobile-friendly UI.
- [Image Generator](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/image-generator): Full-stack AI image generator with prompt input, live preview, and downloads. Node/Express backend proxies OpenAI API with secure key management.
- [Vertical Video Extender](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/video-extender): Transforms horizontal videos into vertical format by generating missing visual space. Flask/OpenCV backend with responsive UI and mobile preview.
- [Picture Converter](https://2025-website-portfolio.vercel.app/work/picture-converter): Converts HEIC to JPG with batch folder support using Pillow/HEIF. Lightweight CLI utility for quick image prep and sharing.
